hints.title: Each rectangle has a limiting bar
hints.body: The rectangle's height is the shortest bar it includes.

hints.title: Find the boundaries
hints.body: For each bar, the widest rectangle of that height extends to the nearest shorter bar on each side.

hints.title: Monotonic stack
hints.body: Keep indices with increasing heights. A shorter bar arriving pops taller bars and fixes their right boundary.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
stack = []
best = 0
for index from 0 to n (with a sentinel height 0 at n):
    height = heights[index] or 0
    while stack and heights[stack.top] > height:
        bar = stack.pop()
        width = index if stack is empty else index - stack.top - 1
        best = max(best, heights[bar] * width)
    push index
return best
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
